subject.title: fix(memory-core): dreaming narrative subagent receives full generic prompt instead of minimal

question: Should plugin subagents gain a new bare/custom prompt profile for owner-supplied prompts, or should the existing `none` mode be changed to retain `extraSystemPrompt`?
rationale: The bug needs less than current `minimal`, but current `none` discards the narrative prompt; choosing either path establishes shared plugin and agent prompt semantics that should not be inferred by automation.

options.title: Add a bare/custom profile
options.body: Add a distinct mode that retains the owner-provided prompt while suppressing all generic sections, preserving existing `minimal` and `none` behavior.

options.title: Change `none` semantics
options.body: Make `none` retain `extraSystemPrompt`, with compatibility analysis and regression coverage for every existing `none` caller.

options.title: Accept the partial reduction
options.body: Keep `minimal`, knowingly retaining generic tooling, skills, approval, workspace, and runtime instructions in Dreaming narratives.

recommendation.title: Add a bare/custom profile
recommendation.body: Add a distinct mode that retains the owner-provided prompt while suppressing all generic sections, preserving existing `minimal` and `none` behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent Dreaming and system-prompt review history makes this the strongest available routing candidate for the cross-boundary API choice.
